topic: Contiguous Memory Allocation for Multi-Dimensional Arrays Using malloc
explanation: In advanced C programming, allocating a multi-dimensional array as a single contiguous block of memory enhances cache performance and simplifies pointer arithmetic. Instead of creating an array of pointers to rows, allocating a single block with malloc ensures data locality and allows for efficient traversal and manipulation of multi-dimensional data structures, which is crucial in high-performance or memory-sensitive applications.
